text_block_list.text:
Today is the Fan Appreciation Festival! 
Umamusume engage with fans through various 
events, but—

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
—Your Highness, the safety inspection is 
complete. There are no issues, so we will 
be watching from outside.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. However... are you 
truly sure about this?

“—Normally, she wouldn't have been allowed 
to participate this time.”

Her popularity only continued to soar 
after her success in the Classic Year. For 
this event only, it was deemed that safety 
couldn't be guaranteed amid the packed 
crowd of fans. However—

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
“—So you are saying that no matter what, 
you wish for Her Highness to participate 
in the festivities.”

A little while ago, I negotiated directly 
with the Captain of the Royal Guard to 
allow Fine Motion to participate. Because 
I believed it was absolutely necessary for 
her sake.
choice_data_list:
I don't want you to get used to being 
lonely.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
"‘...I respect Your Highness from the 
bottom of my heart. That is why I have 
followed you as my master. However...’"

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
"...I will convince the national 
headquarters. Would you be willing to 
cooperate?"

And so, representing the academy, I 
cleared it with headquarters and was 
granted permission to participate.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You must have worked so hard for this. 
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work as well, 
Captain.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
My duty is to protect Her Highness's 
academy life. Simply skipping out wasn't 
something my pride would allow.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I see. Thank you so much, both of 
you.

text_block_list.name: Campus Broadcast
text_block_list.text:
"Our next event is the Running Quiz! 
Participating students, please gather 
round!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Looks like it's starting! Well then, 
I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion!! Do your beeeest!!

Amidst the loud cheers of the fans, the 
Running Quiz event began—

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
“—Flawless so far! Arriving in 1st place, 
it's Fine Motion! Here comes your final 
question!”

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
"There is a famous musical song that 
starts with 'Do', but what does this 'Do' 
mean in English?"

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, an English question! This one's a 
freebie!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Do-re-mi~ re-do, Do-re-mi-re-do-re~♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah, I made a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Th-That just now... no matter how you look 
at it, that was *that* song, wasn't 
it...!?

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Every single thing is wrong, 
right? Too bad, incorrect answer~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahaha~, I just couldn't help singing♪

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Is Fine Motion... actually pretty 
eccentric...?

Though she missed the quiz question, Fine 
Motion certainly got the crowd hyped up.

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
"A ramen shop by the station's north exit 
called 'Ken-Ken-Gaku-Gaku'. The owner—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The answer is "Ikebukuro"!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oooohh~~~~?! An instant answer!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The rest of the question is probably: 
"Which station is home to the original 
shop where this owner trained?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Originally, the shop owner trained at two 
different restaurants—'Outspoken Debate' 
and 'Clamorous Hubbub'..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"At 'Kankan-Gakugaku', you mostly learn 
business management. Because the roots of 
the ramen itself lie in 'Kenken-Gougou', 
Ikebukuro is the correct answer in this 
case!"

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Fine Motion-san, spot on! 
This was an ultra-difficult question that 
even hardcore ramen fans get wrong, so 
that's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The shop's name is a hint too, you know! 
Look, it starts with "Kenken"!♪

text_block_list.name: Self-proclaimed Ramen Connoisseur
text_block_list.text:
Such deep love and knowledge for ramen... 
Fine Motion is not to be underestimated. 
Could she be the Black Ship of the ramen 
world...?

And so, Fine Motion achieved a brilliant 
result, sending the crowd into a wild 
frenzy!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa, I'm toasty warm! And I only ran 
lightly, too!
choice_data_list:
The enthusiasm from the fans was 
incredible too.

The enthusiasm from the fans was 
incredible too, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it really is—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Fiiine!! Fine Motion, go for it!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Looking good, Fine! Go for it...—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The cheers calling "Fine Motion" sounded 
much clearer than usual.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Why do they cheer for me with so much 
passion, I wonder?
choice_data_list:
Because I'm completely in love with your 
running.

Because I'm completely captivated by your 
running.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Does that mean—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
U-Um...! Do you have a moment right 
now...!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I... I really want to thank Fine-san!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: A token of gratitude...?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Thank you for running with such 
joy... Wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I never even considered that it was okay 
to enjoy racing. I thought only the strong 
were allowed to do that."

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Still... watching Fine-san run, I felt 
something slowly unwinding inside me...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I was just thinking how nice it is. 
Racing looks like so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“—I want to run like Fine-san does. 
Suddenly, I just felt this huge burst of 
motivation!”

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm still weak right now, but... one day, 
I want to run strong and beautiful races 
just like Fine-san!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...How strange. It used to be nothing but 
fun."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was so happy, so blissful... it felt 
like a dream. I knew this time would 
eventually fade away, so I thought I had 
to enjoy it with all my might.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That was all it was. And yet, everyone is 
calling my name.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Saying that you want to run like me...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I ended up wishing it would never end. 
Even after crossing the finish line, I 
wanted the race to keep going forever and 
ever—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—As if something like that could never 
end...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Even though I can't... be there anymore...
choice_data_list: An end comes for everyone eventually.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, I know. That's why..."
choice_data_list: But it's not like everything will be gone

text_block_list.text:
Just as that Umamusume was inspired by 
Fine Motion's running, the emotion 
remains. Memories and impressions live on 
in our hearts.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
How can you be so sure? Everyone will 
surely forget, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Like even the perfume fades away into the 
air. Am I the only one who will go on 
carrying these memories?
choice_data_list:
If only it could become the "foundation" 
of everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—To become the cornerstone of my 
homeland's prosperity. That is my mission.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Coming to terms with my own feelings... 
—to become a cornerstone of my homeland."

So that the things dear to her don't 
become nails that crucify her heart.
choice_data_list: As the foundation of the Twinkle Series—

text_block_list.text:
An unforgettable memory that will become a 
lifelong aspiration for Umamusume running 
the Twinkle Series... and something fans 
will talk about for the rest of their 
lives...!
choice_data_list:
Let's leave them with the shock that is 
Fine Motion!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...You're surprisingly reckless, too. 
There's no way to prove an impact even 
happened, right?"
choice_data_list: But if you do that, you won't be lonely.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...If I could really do that... If I 
could leave a lasting impression in 
everyone's hearts... That would truly make 
me so happy."
choice_data_list:
It's a pity I can't show you what's in my 
heart.
It's a shame I can't show you my heart.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "...Will I be there?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I see~...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I hope they're smiling. I hope they're 
running as much as they want..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, that's right. If I want to leave 
a lasting impression of the me I wish to 
be, I have no choice but to race."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Everything— shall be proven at the 
Takarazuka Kinen.
